entryWatch.setup: DG discount-retail reclaim - Dollar General reported fiscal Q2 2026 on 2026-08-27 am, EPS 2.23 against a 1.99 estimate, a 12.06% beat verified on a live per-symbol pull. The 8/27 gap was fully round-tripped by the 8/28 close of 122.89, eleven cents above the 122.78 pre-print close, and the name then RECLAIMED: 8/31 opened 123.47, held 122.725 and closed 126.75 for +3.14% on 4.19M shares against roughly 2M typical, taking back the 125.89 close of the reaction bar. SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 128.40 limit for 3 shares, CLEAN, no checklist item marked fail. CONFIRMED at 10:22, 11:22, 12:22 and again at 13:22, the limit untouched on all four passes. AT 13:22 THE THESIS IS WEAKER THAN IT HAS BEEN: the off-price leg the entry named as its own counterweight has crossed to green, BURL +1.76%, so the trade-down rotation now reads as a broader retail bid that discount still leads. No named invalidation has fired and the limit is neither raised nor killed.
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED LIVE AT 13:22 BY THE FOURTH HOURLY RE-QUOTE, NOT KILLED, AND THE LIMIT IS UNCHANGED AT 128.40 FOR A FOURTH HOUR. DG is 131.00 bid / 131.05 ask at 2026-09-01T17:22:39.035397186Z, last 131.025, +3.35% against a 126.75 settled close, on a 0.05 spread or 0.038% of mark - the tightest quoted all session. THE HEADLINE THIS HOUR IS AN EROSION, NOT A CONFIRMATION DRESSED UP AS ONE. BURL, the off-price name the 09:47 entry named explicitly as the counterweight proving this was a trade-down rotation rather than a retail bounce, is 264.33 bid at +1.76% - green, and decisively so, after -2.32% at the strike, -1.88% at 10:22, -1.08% at 11:22 and +0.18% at 12:22. Five consecutive checks of monotonic recovery. BBY is green too at +1.42%, so the split reads EIGHT-FOR-TEN against nine-for-ten an hour ago, and the entry's specific proof is gone. WHAT SURVIVES IS STATED WITH EQUAL PRECISION: the named invalidation is not the cohort blurring but DLTR giving back its whole move and closing red while DG also closes red, and DLTR is 130.95 bid at +3.44%; and the leadership ORDERING is intact even as breadth widens, DLTR +3.44% and DG +3.35% still the top two of ten with BURL third, WSM -2.83%, ANF -1.82%, GAP -1.34%, TJX -0.18%, ROST -0.11%. The honest formulation is that the rotation has BROADENED into a retail bid that discount still leads - a weaker claim than the entry made, recorded as weaker. INVALIDATION ONE, a trade below 126.24: NOT TRIGGERED across all forty-six bars of the 13:30Z-17:15Z series, the level set on the opening bar and never revisited. A CORRECTION RATHER THAN A REPEAT: the 11:21 and 12:22 rows put the lowest low since the open at 129.9638 and 128.19 respectively, and this run's pull shows 127.10 on the 13:35Z bar. No conclusion changes, but a number carried forward wrong is how a level ends up unverified. INVALIDATION TWO, a close below 125.89: PENDING, DG 4.03% above it. THE 12:22 DISTRIBUTION READ DID NOT CARRY THROUGH: DG faded to a 129.765 low on the 17:05Z bar, the lowest since 14:00Z, then was bought back to 131.00 on 25,350, 17,185 and 35,669 shares, the last the third-heaviest bar of the session, making a fresh higher low far above the limit. FILL PROBABILITY DETERIORATED AGAIN to 2.60 or 1.98% below the bid against 1.41% at 12:22, and the last print through 128.40 was the 13:45Z bar's 128.375 low some three and a half hours ago. THE LIMIT IS STILL NOT RAISED - widening the time was never permission to widen the price - AND STILL NOT KILLED, because the written kill conditions are the three invalidations, a limit outside the spread, or the setup being gone, and a limb that softened is not a condition that fired. Expires 15:30 ET today, 128 minutes out.
entryWatch.why: Item 3 is na on a dated fact rather than skipped: DG's next report is 2026-12-03 on a live per-symbol pull, three months past the 9/8 time stop, so there is no earnings hold for a straddle to precede. moves.json branch one is checked and does not bind - it covers AVGO itself and semiconductor or enterprise-software sympathy names, and a discount retailer is neither. THE COHORT READ IS THE LOAD-BEARING PART AND IT IS A SPLIT, NOT A RALLY: DLTR +2.62%, WMT +0.59% and DG +1.69% bid while TJX -0.43%, ROST -0.74%, BURL -2.32%, WSM -2.58%, BBY -0.50%, ANF -0.41% and GAP -0.45% are red. Retail is not bouncing; deep-discount trade-down names are being bought on a second consecutive risk-off day. DG is the LAGGARD of the bid pair and the only one carrying a fresh catalyst, which is the sympathy-laggard setup the rulebook names. THE WEAKNESS, STATED BEFORE THE OUTCOME: this is a RECLAIM, not the day-2 continuation the rulebook prefers, because a fully round-tripped gap has no move left to continue. Yesterday this board refused DG in exactly those terms and took SJM instead; that refusal is confronted rather than reversed in silence, and what changed is two sessions of evidence. OPTIONS REFUSED ON SPREAD: the 3-6 week window on DG contains only weeklies - 9/18 is 2.4 weeks, 10/16 is 6.4 weeks, so both monthlies are excluded by the rule itself - and the tightest of eight near-money 10/02 calls quotes 40.6% of mark with zero volume, widening to 95.1%, while the 9/25 128c quotes 73.9%. Equity quotes 0.31%.

The 8/31 reaction bar opened 140.39, ran 142.66, printed a 127.10 low and closed 128.22 on 1.86M shares against roughly 400k typical - a gap-and-fade that gave back nearly all of an 11.5% pop. Today opened 127.01 and printed 124.05 within five minutes, so the name is now BELOW its own 125.96 pre-print close and BELOW yesterday's 127.10 low. entryWatch.why: Recorded at length because it is the control case that gives DG's reclaim its meaning: two names, two round-tripped earnings gaps, and only one of them turned on rising volume. SAIC also had the larger beat, which is the point - the size of the beat did not decide the outcome and the tape did. The 0.95 spread on a 124.835 mark, 0.76%, is a second and independent mark against it.

entryWatch.trigger: NOT RE-STRUCK, AND THE REASON IS THE SETUP RATHER THAN THE PRICE. SJM is 131.80 bid / 132.40 ask at 2026-09-01T13:42:19.983Z, last 132.25, +0.49% against a 131.16 settled close, so the dead 132.10 limit is back inside the spread and could in principle be published again. It is not, because the thing that justified it is gone: the 8/31 bar made a lower low at 131.15 and a lower close at 131.16, breaking the rising-lows sequence of 128.12, 128.90, 131.10, 131.645 that was the entire technical case, and the relative-strength read failed outright on its eighth check at -0.816% against SPY -0.356%. A level that is available again is not the same as a setup that is still there.
entryWatch.why: Kept as the record of a distinction this board has to keep making: the 15:21 kill was mechanical, on the limit sitting above the offer, and was explicitly NOT the 131.10 invalidation firing. Today the invalidation still has not fired - the 8/31 low was 131.15, five cents above it - and the entry is still refused. That is the correct shape: a spec can die on price and the thesis can die separately and later, and blurring them is how a board talks itself back into a trade.
